whatChanged.theMeasuredDefect: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs sanitizeAndFlatten calls form.updateFieldAppearances() before flatten(). pdf-lib's PDFCheckBox.needsAppearancesUpdate returns true for any widget whose CURRENT /AS state has no entry in /AP /N, and its default provider answers with a stroked square the size of the widget rectangle, which flatten() then stamps onto the page. ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 says a viewer draws the stream named by /AS, so where there is none a conforming viewer paints nothing. Read from the pinned binaries in this container: 200-00130 carries 12 non-pushbutton button widgets and all 12 are /AS /Off with /Yes as the only state in /AP /N; 200-00132 carries 2 and both are the same; 600-00228 carries 6 and all 6 ship their own /Off. 12 + 2 = the 14 squares VF02 measured.
whatChanged.theSharedModule: rcap-active-content.mjs gains one exported function, suppressSynthesizedSelectionAppearances(pdfDoc, form, writtenFields), and one OPT-IN option on sanitizeAndFlatten named suppressSynthesizedAppearances, default false. When on, it runs immediately after restrictWidgetContributions and immediately before updateFieldAppearances: for every check-box or radio widget whose field is not in writtenFields and whose current /AS state has no stream under /AP /N, it installs an EMPTY form XObject for that state, with a /BBox sized to the widget's own /Rect, an identity /Matrix, empty /Resources and zero-length content. pdf-lib then reports no update is needed, synthesizes nothing, and flattens a stream that paints nothing. The remedy supplies the state the source omitted rather than suppressing a drawing, which is why it needs no new rule about what may be drawn.
whatChanged.howTheClassificationIsMade: By pdf-lib's own field classes (PDFCheckBox, PDFRadioGroup) and by three structural facts on the widget: whether /AS is a name, whether /AP /N is a dictionary, and whether that dictionary carries the /AS key. No family, form number, field name, caption, jurisdiction or route is read anywhere in the function. There is no list of any kind in it.
whatChanged.whatIsNeverTouched: A widget whose /AS state already has a stream (600-00228's six, which are the court's own and which RI-OFF-APPEARANCE settles stay); a widget of a field this run wrote, so a ticked box still renders its mark from the /Yes stream this never goes near; text fields, choosers and pushbuttons; a widget with no /AS; a widget whose /AP /N is a bare stream. The last two and the first are counted in the report as skippedNoAppearanceState, skippedNonDictionaryAppearance and skippedStateAlreadyDrawn so the skips can be checked rather than trusted.

controls: 1 NEGATIVE CONTROL. With the option OFF, an unwritten box whose /AS /Off state has no appearance and whose /AP /N carries /Yes alone is delivered as a bordered square: 240 dark pixels in the widget rect. The test asserts this is greater than zero and fails loudly if it is not, because a test that passes either way proves nothing.
